writeup.headline: Nutanix rates Buy on a net-cash balance sheet, strong cash generation, re-accelerating growth and firm price trend.
writeup.thesis: Nutanix scores 75, a Buy, with its strongest factor being the balance sheet (98): it holds net cash, with net debt to FCF of -1.2 and cash covering debt 1.75 times. Valuation scores 88. Against its own history, P/FCF is cheaper than at 38 of the last 50 month-ends and P/S is near the middle of the last 50 month-ends, so overall it sits near the middle of its own history. Growth (68) is helped by TTM revenue growth of 12.4% and latest-quarter revenue growth of 15.9% year on year, as growth sped up by 5.9 pp from the previous quarter. Quality (71) rests on an 86.8% gross margin and a 29.5% FCF margin, offset by a thin 9.6% operating margin and stock-based pay at 12.5% of revenue. The price trend (80) is strong: the price is 39.4% above its 200-day average and 2.5% below its 52-week high, while news risk is neutral at 51.
key_risks: The CEO, CFO and a director sold shares in a cluster on Oct 6–12 under 10b5-1 plans, with the CFO cutting her direct holding by about 71.5%.
After running 67.1 pp ahead of SPY over the last 126 trading days, the shares could give back gains if sentiment on the VMware-replacement opportunity fades.
Operating margin of 9.6% is modest and stock-based compensation is 12.5% of revenue, so GAAP profitability lags cash flow.
The chief commercial officer's departure is a sales-leadership change that could disrupt execution.
Longer-term momentum is weak, with shares down 1.9% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago.
what_would_change: A 5-point rise in the score would lift the rating to Strong Buy, for example from further growth acceleration or an improved news-risk score.
An 11-point drop would push it to Hold, which could come from growth slowing again, a reversal in the price trend, or more negative news such as further insider selling or a guidance cut.
Next quarterly results versus the FY27 outlook will test whether the growth re-acceleration holds.
